summary: Iteration 40: UI Enhancement Testing - All features verified. Create Project modal with tabs (Details/Team), Grid/List view toggle, and enhanced My Tasks page all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate data-testid attribute on line 562-563 in MyTasks.jsx: `data-testid="tab-${tab.id}"` appears twice on same element
